# External Asset Credits

Ashenmoon uses selected files from these asset packs for runtime visuals.

## Free Topdown Fantasy - Forest - Pixelart Tileset

- Author: aamatniekss
- Source: https://aamatniekss.itch.io/topdown-fantasy-forest
- Imported files:
  - `topdown-fantasy-forest/Tileset.png`
  - `topdown-fantasy-forest/Decorations.png`
- License summary from the asset page: usable in free and commercial projects; modification allowed; credit appreciated but not required; assets may not be redistributed or resold on their own; assets may not be used for NFTs or AI creations.

## Pixelart Forest Top-Down RPG Asset Pack v2

- Author: zedpxl
- Source: https://zedpxl.itch.io/pixelart-forest-asset-pack
- Imported files:
  - `pixel-16-woods/free_pixel_16_woods.png`
- License summary from the asset page: free and paid versions are usable in commercial and non-commercial projects; modification allowed; assets may not be resold or redistributed, even modified; assets may not be used for AI or NFT related things.

## Excluded Pack

- `Cute_Fantasy_Free.zip` is intentionally not imported. Its bundled free-version readme says the assets are for non-commercial projects only.
